textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Plants and Animals Live Together · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Elephants feed on grass, a moth rests on a leaf and a caterpillar chews a leaf. Earthworms live on leaves and in the soil.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Elephants feed on grass, a moth rests on a leaf and a caterpillar chews a leaf. Earthworms live on leaves and in the soil.
beats.speakEn: Elephants feed on grass, a moth rests on a leaf and a caterpillar chews a leaf. Earthworms live on leaves and in the soil.

beats.en: Animals, birds and insects use different parts of plants for food, shelter and resting. Camels eat the leaves of plants. Monkeys love eating the fruits of plants.
